summary: community.general 13 also removed KeycloakAPI.add_user_in_group, known_hosts utils, locale_gen ubuntu_legacy, oci_vcn (use oracle.oci), the oneandone modules and oracle doc fragments.

answer_card.title: community.general 13 removals (part 2)
answer_card.answer_md:
- keycloak module utils: `KeycloakAPI.add_user_in_group()` removed.
- `known_hosts` module utils removed.
- `locale_gen`: `ubuntu_legacy` removed; only `glibc` mechanism remains.
- `oci_vcn` removed; use **`oracle.oci.oci_network_vcn`**.
- `oneandone` module utils and all `oneandone_*` modules removed.
- `oracle` doc fragment and `oracle.oci_utils` module utils removed.
